properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 10:52PM MST until September 14 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Havasu Creek basin in...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 500 AM MST Monday.

* At 1052 PM MST, Heavy rain has ended. Earlier between 0.5 and 1.5
inches of rain have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Havasu Creek basin.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Havasu Creek basin.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Little Navajo Falls, Mooney Falls, Beaver Falls, Hualapai Hilltop,
Havasupai Reservation and Supai.

This includes the Colorado River between river miles 156 and 158.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes on Havasu Creek near Supai.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Colorado River, Sinyella Canyon, Heather Wash, Pasture Wash, Little
Coyote Canyon, Havasu Creek and Black Tank Wash.
properties.instruction:
Campers and hikers should hustle to higher ground immediately! Stay
away from creeks and washes!

Foot bridges will be washed out in Supai Campground. Some campsites
will be flooded. Campers may be stranded in portions of the
campground.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 13 at 11:51PM MDT by NWS Billings MT
properties.description:
At 1151 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Alzada, or 54 miles southeast of Broadus, moving northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Alzada and Albion.
properties.instruction:
Monitor the weather situation closely and be alert for threatening
weather conditions.

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 13 at 11:49PM MDT by NWS Great Falls MT
properties.description:
At 1148 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from 18 miles southeast of Parker School to 20 miles
west of Hays. Movement was northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Cleveland and Lloyd.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.
properties.area: Northern Blaine County; Bears Paw Mountains and Southern Blaine

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued September 13 at 11:11PM MDT by NWS Billings MT
properties.description:
At 1111 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 11
miles northwest of Alzada, or 47 miles southeast of Broadus, moving
northeast at 30 mph. Other strong thunderstorms south of Alzada in
Wyoming will track across southern Carter County as well.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and pea size hail. Brief heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Ridgeway, Alzada, Albion and Capitol.
properties.instruction:
Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with this storm.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued September 13 at 9:33PM MST until September 13 at 11:30PM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...North Central Cochise County in southeastern Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 1130 PM MST.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous flows over low-water crossings. Some low-water
crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 933 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This will cause small stream flooding. Between 0.5
and 1.2 inches of rain have fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Willcox, Pearce-Sunsites, Cochise and Kansas Settlement.
- This includes the following highways...
Route 191 between mile markers 42 and 66. Interstate 10 between
mile markers 331 and 343. Route 186 between mile markers 327 and
333.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
